description: This file is an HTML document that implements a web-based database visualizer interface for browsing and viewing database tables and data. It includes CSS styles for layout and styling, and JavaScript code for fetching database information, loading tables and data, and managing user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying tabular data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cell values, handling null, object, or lengthy values.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or contracts cell content for objects or long text values.
